description: TRA (臺鐵) trains from one station to another on a day: train type, departure, arrival, travel time, from now on for today. TDX covers about two months ahead. Example: from "臺北", to "花蓮", date "2026-10-23".

after.description: Only departures at or after this time, HH:mm (default: now for today, else 00:00).

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

from.description: Departure TRA station: name (臺北, 台中, Hualien) or station ID (1000).

limit.description: Maximum number of trains to return (default 10).

to.description: Arrival TRA station: name (臺北, 台中, Hualien) or station ID (1000).

name: tra_timetable
title: Taiwan Railway timetable
